lessons.title: Past events in sequence
lessons.objective: Past events in sequence: Use the passé composé for completed events and connectors such as d'abord, ensuite and finalement to order them; time words like hier set the context.
lessons.explanation:

lessons.title: Short irregular participles
lessons.objective: Short irregular participles: Key verbs have short irregular participles: avoir → eu, être → été, pouvoir → pu, devoir → dû, vouloir → voulu; être itself takes avoir: j'ai été.

lessons.objective: Explain a decision and answer an objection: Bien que (+ subjonctif) and même si (+ indicative) introduce a concession; pourtant contrasts two statements; c'est pourquoi gives a consequence.
